Verify a simulation ensemble against the C5 contract

Source: R/ensemble_source.R
verify_fb_ensemble.Rd

Checks that e honours the ensemble-source contract (inst/ensemble_source_contract.md): row-aligned positive-length params / outputs, any observed names a subset of the outputs, any output_dims one row per output column, and a provenance$source. Returns a verdict rather than erroring, so callers can branch (the fb_ensemble() constructor turns a failure into an error; an interactive check can inspect the message).

Usage

verify_fb_ensemble(e)

Arguments

e

An object to check (an fb_ensemble, or any list with the same components).

Value

A list list(ok = <logical>, message = <character>). ok = TRUE and an empty message on conformance; ok = FALSE and the first violation otherwise.
